hero.heading: Crafting Extraordinary Journeys Across India
hero.description: TourTripHolidays is your premier domestic travel partner. From snow-clad Himalayan heights to tranquil coastal backwaters, we deliver bespoke holiday experiences tailored to your dreams.

who_we_are.label: ABOUT TOURTRIPHOLIDAYS
who_we_are.heading: Dedicated to Making Every Journey Unforgettable
who_we_are.paragraph_1: TourTripHolidays was established with a singular, passionate mission: to simplify travel across India and deliver authentic, unforgettable domestic holiday experiences. We believe that true travel is not merely about visiting popular sights, but about immersing yourself in the rich culture, flavors, landscapes, and heartfelt hospitality of every destination.
who_we_are.paragraph_2: Our experienced domestic travel planners craft every itinerary with meticulous precision—selecting trusted premium hotels, providing verified local guides, and ensuring seamless private transfers so you can explore India with absolute comfort and total peace of mind.

highlights.title: Customized Itineraries
highlights.desc: Tailor-made to your pace and budget

mission_vision.label: OUR PURPOSE & VALUES
mission_vision.heading: Guided by Passion, Driven by Excellence
mission_vision.mission_desc: Our mission is to make domestic travel accessible, hassle-free, and deeply rewarding for every traveler by delivering high-quality, transparent, and thoughtfully personalized tour packages across India.
mission_vision.vision_desc: Our vision is to be recognized as the foremost domestic holiday specialist in India, renowned for ethical pricing, authentic local experiences, and unmatched customer satisfaction.

features.title: Customized Travel Experiences
features.description: Every traveler is unique. We tailor domestic itineraries to match your travel pace, personal interests, family needs, and budget.

features.title: Carefully Planned Tour Packages
features.description: Handcrafted itineraries covering India's finest destinations with vetted accommodations, smooth transfers, and well-timed sightseeing.

features.title: Transparent Pricing
features.description: Clear, competitive, and honest pricing with complete inclusions and zero hidden costs. You always know exactly what you are paying for.

features.title: Dedicated Travel Assistance
features.description: From your initial enquiry to the moment you return home safely, our experienced travel specialists are just a call or message away.

explore_india.label: EXPERIENCE INCREDIBLE INDIA
explore_india.heading: Explore the Beauty of India
explore_india.description: From towering Himalayan peaks to tropical coastlines and vibrant heritage, discover diverse travel experiences planned with care.

items.title: Mountain Escapes
items.description: Majestic snow-clad peaks, pine-scented valleys, and serene hill stations across Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.

items.title: Cultural Experiences
items.description: Grand palaces, historic forts, vibrant folk arts, and centuries-old architectural heritage of Rajasthan and Central India.

items.title: Beach Destinations
items.description: Golden sun-kissed sands, swaying coconut palms, and tranquil coastal breezes across Goa, Kerala, and Andaman shores.

items.title: Wildlife and Nature
items.description: Thrilling jungle safaris, protected tiger reserves, and dense biodiversity in Corbett, Ranthambore, and Kaziranga.

items.title: Spiritual Journeys
items.description: Sacred river ghats, ancient temple towns, peaceful ashrams, and timeless spiritual traditions in Varanasi and Rishikesh.

items.title: Adventure Travel
items.description: Exciting river rafting, high-altitude trekking, desert camping, and adrenaline-filled outdoor expeditions across India.

steps.title: Discover Your Destination
steps.description: Tell us your travel dream or choose from our extensive collection of domestic tour packages spanning all 28 states of India.

steps.title: Choose Your Perfect Tour
steps.description: Select a curated package or collaborate with our destination experts to customize stays, sightseeing pace, and transport to your exact needs.

steps.title: Enjoy Your Journey
steps.description: Pack your bags and travel with total peace of mind, supported 24/7 by our dedicated team from arrival to safe return home.

items.question: How do I book a tour package with TourTripHolidays?
items.answer: You can explore our tour packages online, submit a free enquiry, or connect with our travel specialists via WhatsApp or phone. We will provide a tailored itinerary and guide you through a simple, transparent booking process.

items.question: Can packages be customized for families or honeymoon couples?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely! All our tour packages can be tailored to match your specific preferences, travel dates, hotel category, and pace.

items.question: Are flights and train tickets included in the packages?
items.answer: Our standard packages focus on land arrangements (hotels, transfers, sightseeing, and meals). However, our team can gladly assist with domestic flights and train tickets upon request.

items.question: What is your policy on transparent pricing?
items.answer: We provide upfront, itemized inclusions with zero hidden fees. What you see in your final approved quote is exactly what you pay.

items.question: How will I receive support during my travel?
items.answer: You will have a dedicated trip coordinator available via call and WhatsApp 24/7 throughout your entire holiday in India.

cta.heading: Ready to Experience Incredible India?
cta.description: Let us take care of all the planning while you create memories that will last a lifetime.
